title: Implement Structured Error Handling
problem_statement: The codebase lacks structured error handling, increasing the risk of unhandled exceptions and security vulnerabilities.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased risk of application crashes and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Refactor the code to use try-catch blocks for error handling.
success_criteria: All critical paths have structured error handling.

provenance.evidence: No try-catch blocks for error handling.
